_readme: S713 (worker for SkyKittiwake), census lever 4 (City College of San Francisco, page not found, 53): the 22 credit programs. Capture 39046623474 read them as not_found against the 2026-27 catalog PDF. This read prints every page up to 480 that names one of their titles, so a session can tell whether each program has its own page (title, award, requirement list) and which codes it prints. One load and robots.txt, no model call, nothing written. Programs: AV Technologist 37160; Administrative Support 05447; Aircraft Powerplant Maintenance Technology 05469/22726; Airframe Maintenance Technology 05468; Airframe-Maintenance Technology 22725; Avionics-Maintenance Technology 05467; Broadcast Motion Graphics 35709; Cal-GETC 45768; Computer Accounting 09175; Data Journalism 09178; Finance 05440/22721; Human Resources Management 40435/40590; Liberal Arts and Sciences Emphasis in Arts and Humanities 17952; Liberal Arts and Sciences Emphasis in Science and Mathematics 17954; Maker Studies 37776; Multimedia Studies: Performance Arts 11817; Office Technology 17842; Technical Theater Production - Costume and Makeup 40171; Technical Theater Production - Stagecraft 40407. Cal-GETC 45768 is searched as a certificate title only, so the Cal-GETC pattern every transfer degree names does not spend the page cap.
